summary: Hiker activated a SPOT beacon on a remote section of the Colorado Trail in Saguache County after drinking contaminated water caused weakness and dehydration; six Saguache SAR personnel reached the location by 4x4, UTV, and a half-mile hike through downed timber, made contact, and hiked the survivor out to vehicles; all out of the field by 01:00.
location: Remote section of the Colorado Trail
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page.
